mandate: MAIN is a setup command desk, not a research warehouse. Coverage and raw discovery stay off MAIN unless operator-promoted.

operator_notes.main_vs_warehouse: MAIN shows ~60 setup-shaped names from allowlisted sources (operator, hermes, portfolio, pullback_macd, trade_ai_go, prev_traded, personal_watchlist). The full watchlist_items warehouse (~12k rows) includes RESEARCH/ToS/ai_discovered buckets — not auto-flooded onto MAIN.
operator_notes.etf_funds: ETFs and mutual funds are not hard-banned. ~474 fund rows live in the warehouse but rarely reach MAIN because screener/ai_discovered ETF lists are excluded from M1 source allowlist and the ticket/propose path is equity-setup shaped. When a fund is on MAIN, Decision Desk shows fund look-through + volume N/A criteria (same as Re-Entry).
operator_notes.defense_sector_flow: Soft-auto MAIN WAIT for income/defensive Defense destinations (SCHD + lean-sector ETFs XLU/XLP/XLV when defensive_lean enabled). Cyclical destinations (XLK, XLF, …) require one-click Promote to MAIN on the Defense desk. Never auto-GO; never broker-write.

proposal_bridge.note: watchlist_proposal_bridge only emits from MAIN GO when enabled
